newsitem.title: GERMANY: German M3 poll - Forecasts for February M3.
newsitem.headline: German M3 poll - Forecasts for February M3.

text.p: Following are the results of a poll of 11 economists on German February M3 data which is expected to be announced this week.
In January, German M3 growth was a higher-than-expected 11.7 percent versus Q4 1996 and 8.6 percent versus Q4 1995, on an annualised, seasonally adjusted basis.
Q. What is your forecast for February M3 growth?
Olaf Liedke, Helaba Frankfurt 8.5 pct 9.0 pct
Elanie Heldmann, BfG Bank 8.7 pct 11.1 pct
Volker Nitsch, Bankges. Berlin 8.6 pct 10.4 pct
Joerg Henzler, JP Morgan, Frankfurt 9.1 pct 11.0 pct
Ulrich Jochheim, DG Bank, Frankfurt 8.5 pct 10.0 pct
Petra Koehler, Dresdner Bank 8.3 pct 9.4 pct
Adolf Rosenstock, IBJ Frankfurt 8.5 pct 10.5 pct
Nobuaki Hori, Daiwa Europe, Frankf. 8.4 pct 9.8 pct
Alison Cottrell, Paine Webber, Lon. 8.5 pct 9.7 pct
Gernot Nerb, Salomon Brothers, Fra. 8.3 pct 9.5 pct
Nikolaus Keis, Bayr. Vereinsbank 8.6 pct 11.0 pct
